- **Ceded to Other Companies 2006**: $4,782 million (from `documents/report.md`)

\[ \text{Ratio} = \frac{\text{Direct Amount 2008}}{\text{Ceded to Other Companies 2008}} = \frac{14,800}{5,652} \approx 2.62 \]
